purpose: Product-intent confirmation record. For each submitted link: intended ASIN, official listing URL, confirmation date, and source. Observed redirect targets are kept in a separate field and are never merged with the official listing URL.
rule: Amazon's ASIN definition provides a checkable identifier. Do not claim the supplied short links are invalid; their exact compliance status is unresolved (++FLG-003++). Validate one link per product in the enrolled Associates workflow (destination + tracking report) before scaling.

records.intendedAsinStatus: unverified — 9 characters; Amazon ASINs are exactly 10 alphanumeric characters (IR-01)
records.officialListingUrlStatus: blank — not confirmed from an official Amazon source
records.confirmationDateStatus: blank — not yet confirmed in the enrolled Associates workflow
records.redirectTargetStatus: blank — observed redirect target, stored separately from officialListingUrl; not yet captured
records.workflowStage: pending validation — test one link per product before scaling
